note: Cardarine/GW501516. Stesso composto (C1) di 10.3390/pharmaceutics16050623, i cui valori di fusione ed energie reticolari di GW-1...GW-5 coincidono con quelli citati qui; in questo articolo i polimorfi GW-1...GW-5 compaiono solo come riferimento al rif. 11 nella Table 2 e nel confronto delle energie reticolari, quindi non sono forme di questa estrazione: i loro punti di fusione e le energie reticolari stanno nell'extra come citati). Nessun CCDC ne' refcode nel testo. Eventi: tracce DTA/TGA delle nuove forme (transizioni, desolvatazioni, fusioni, degradazione), bipiridina pura, stabilita' a 40 °C e 75% RH. Non sono eventi: solubilita' in acqua (UV), lo spostamento ipotizzato dell'H del COOH verso S2 (interpretazione IR), le energie. Difetti del testo: (1) riferimenti a figure sbagliati nel confronto dei punti di fusione («in the cocrystal (Figure 7c) ... than in bipyridine (Figure 7d)»); (2) lattice energy di GW-SO: Table 3 «−210.6», testo «−211.1 kJ/mol»; (3) GW-SO2 con T «250(60)» in Table 1; (4) la GW-SO con peso formula 938.97 per formula C21H18F3NO4S2; (5) la didascalia di Table 2 chiama «GW1 to GW-5» i polimorfi citati; (6) «B3LYP/6-31H(d,p)» nel testo. Frasi dei metodi di sintesi: «obtained from a mixture with nitromethane» (composizione non detta).

composti.nome: mono-oxidized cardarine (C21H18F3NO4S2, sulfoxide derivative of cardarine)
dioxidized cardarine (C21H18F3NO5S2, sulfone derivative of cardarine)

forme.citazione: The crystalline powder of cardarine was received from Wuhan Shu Mai Technology Co. (Wuhan, China)
forme.note: Cardarine di partenza (polvere cristallina commerciale); nel testo la forma non e' identificata (non dice se sia uno dei polimorfi GW-1..GW-5 del rif. 11). Sigla «GW» nei dati UV («AGW», «CGW») e «GW cardarine start compound» nella didascalia della Figure 7.

motivi_hb.chi: carboxyl groups of two cardarine molecules
motivi_hb.citazione: The crystal exhibits strong mutual carboxyl···carboxyl O3-H3···O2 hydrogen bonds depicting a R22(8) homosynthon.

forme.citazione: The recrystallization of cardarine in methanol yielded the formation of a new polymorph, which was proven to be monoclinic with the centrosymmetric space group P21/n whose asymmetric unit comprises one molecule as depicted in Figure 1a.
forme.note: Nuovo polimorfo di cardarine (formula C21H18F3NO3S2, senza solvente): anidro presunto. Cella e T dalla Table 1 (colonna GW-6). Nessun CCDC ne' refcode nel testo (i dati di deposito stanno nel supplementare, se ci sono).

motivi_hb.motivo: O-H···N hydrogen bridges (hydroxyl donor to bipyridine nitrogen)
motivi_hb.chi: hydroxyl group of cardarine and nitrogen of bipyridine
motivi_hb.citazione: Within the asymmetric unit, the hydroxyl group acts as a donor in the formation of strong hydrogen bridges with the nitrogen of bipiridine.

forme.citazione: Using the X-ray diffraction method, it was found to be in a stoichiometric ratio of 2:1 between cardarine to bipyridine and to crystallize in the triclinic crystal system (centrosymmetric P-1 space group) with one cardarine molecule in the asymmetric unit (Figure 2a) and half a molecule of bipirydine, which is located on special positions (namely inversion centers of the unit cell corners).
forme.note: Cocristallo 2:1 cardarine:bipiridina (nel testo «bipirydine»). Unita' asimmetrica: una molecola di cardarine e meta' di bipiridina (su un centro di inversione); Z_primo 1 si riferisce alla cardarine. La formula in Table 1 (C26H22F3N2O3S2) e' per una cardarine e mezza bipiridina. Cella e T dalla Table 1.

motivi_hb.motivo: R2^2(7) ring graph set (hydroxyl···carbonyl O3-H···O4 and C22-H···O2)
motivi_hb.citazione: displays a ring like R22(7) graph set motif, which links the cardarine and solvent molecule via hydroxyl···carbonyl O3-H···O4 and C22-H···O2 hydrogen bonds.

motivi_hb.motivo: R2^2(7) motif linking two cardarine molecules and one solvent molecule (C7-H···O4, C6-H···O3, O3-H3···O4)
motivi_hb.chi: two cardarine molecules and one DMF molecule
motivi_hb.citazione: The formation of supramolecular architectures are also sustained by C7-H···O4, C6-H···O3, and O3-H3···O4 hydrogen bonds, which link two cardarine molecules and one solvent molecule in a R22(7) motif.

forme.citazione: The recrystallization of cardarine in a solution of dimethylformamide yielded the formation of a solvate, which embedded dimethylformamide molecules within the lattice found in a stoichiometric ratio of cardarine: dimethylformamide of 1:1.
forme.note: Solvato 1:1 cardarine:DMF. Cella e T dalla Table 1 (colonna GW-DMF).

motivi_hb.motivo: R4^4(12) homosynthon (two cardarine and two methanol molecules bridged via O-H···O)
motivi_hb.chi: two cardarine and two methanol molecules
motivi_hb.citazione: Two cardarine and two solvent molecules are bridged via O-H···O hydrogen bonds and form a R44(12) homosynthon.

forme.citazione: The fourth investigated and reported new solid form of cardarine is the methanol solvate, which has formed in a 1:1 stoichiometric ratio as well as its analogous dimethylformamide solvate. The crystal is a monoclinic with P21/c space group with the asymmetric unit being shown in Figure 4a.
forme.note: Solvato 1:1 cardarine:metanolo. Cella e T dalla Table 1 (colonna GW-MeOH).

motivi_hb.motivo: chains of alternating A and B molecules bridged by carboxyl···sulfoxide O-H···O
motivi_hb.chi: carboxyl group and sulfoxide group of molecules A and B
motivi_hb.citazione: The layout of supramolecular arrangements is comprised by alternant chains of A and B molecules, which are bridged by carboxyl···sulfoxide (O3B-H3B··O4B and O3A-H3A···O4A) (Figure 5b).

forme.citazione: The asymmetric unit of the newly crystalline form includes two individual such molecules (denoted by A and B suffixes, Figure 5a).
forme.note: Derivato mono-ossidato di cardarine (sulfossido sullo zolfo S1 del metilsulfanile), ottenuto per ricristallizzazione in dimetilsolfossido e non piu' riprodotto. Due molecole indipendenti (A e B) nell'unita' asimmetrica: Z_primo 2 per molecola. Il sistema e il gruppo sono dalla Table 1 e dalle conclusioni («GW-SO are centrosymmetric triclinic crystals»). In Table 1 la formula e' C21H18F3NO4S2 (una molecola) ma il peso formula e' 938.97, che corrisponde a due molecole (A e B): riportato come scritto.

motivi_hb.motivo: O3-H3··N1 bonds between the carboxyl group and the thiazole nitrogen
motivi_hb.citazione: in dioxidized GW-SO2, the carboxyl group is bridged to the nitrogen of the thiazole ring by O3-H3··N1 bonds

forme.citazione: Another derivative was obtained by recrystallization in a mixture of nitromethane, which is dioxidized at the methylsulfanyl S2 sulfur
forme.note: Derivato diossidato (solfone) di cardarine, ottenuto da una miscela con nitrometano e non piu' riprodotto. Il testo dice «obtained by recrystallization in a mixture of nitromethane». Temperatura della raccolta in Table 1: «250(60)», con un'incertezza di 60 K non plausibile rispetto alle altre cinque strutture (293(2)): riportata come scritta in T_scritta, nessuna lettura probabile. Sistema e gruppo dalla Table 1 e dalle conclusioni.

forme.citazione: To prove that the cocrystal with 4,4 bipyridine (GW-bipy) has a different thermal behavior compared to the pure coformer (bipyridine), the DTA/TGA curves for it were also recorded (Figure 7d).
forme.note: Coformero puro: il testo non dice la provenienza ne' la forma cristallina.

citazioni: For the GW-6 (Figure 7a), an endothermic peak at ~101 °C is assigned to the heat absorbed by the sample during the process of phase transition in a new phase (most likely a new polymorphic phase).

Differential thermal analysis (DTA) and thermogravimetric analysis (TGA) were conducted concurrently using a Shimadzu DTG-60H instrument. The samples were placed in an open alumina pan and heated from room temperature to 500 °C at a rate of 10 °C per minute, under a nitrogen gas flow of 70 mL/min.
eventi.note: Picco endotermico di GW-6 a ~101 °C, attribuito a una transizione di fase «in a new phase (most likely a new polymorphic phase)»: la fase nuova non e' caratterizzata (a = ignota); la frase e' ipotetica («most likely a new polymorphic phase»). Segue un esotermo a ~105 °C (E2) e la fusione (E3).

citazioni: Shortly after this event, a small exothermic peak appears at ~105 °C, which can be explained by the crystallization process and the rearrangement of cardarine molecules in the lattice.

eventi.lettura_alternativa: La fusione (130 e 134 °C) potrebbe essere quella della fase formatasi dopo la transizione a ~101 °C e la cristallizzazione a ~105 °C (E1, E2), non quella di GW-6 tal quale: il testo la attribuisce a «cardarine» e la Table 2 a GW-6.

citazioni: The DTA trace of GW-MeOH (Figure 7b) exhibits a sharp endothermic peak at 84 °C, which can be attributed to the loss of methanol molecules found within the crystal lattice, which is accompanied by the TGA graph with an experimental mass loss of 5% due to the loss of methanol molecules, which is quite close to the theoretical solvent content of 6.59%.

Differential thermal analysis (DTA) and thermogravimetric analysis (TGA) were conducted concurrently using a Shimadzu DTG-60H instrument. The samples were placed in an open alumina pan and heated from room temperature to 500 °C at a rate of 10 °C per minute, under a nitrogen gas flow of 70 mL/min.
eventi.note: Perdita di metanolo del solvato: picco endotermico netto a 84 °C con perdita di massa sperimentale del 5% (6.59% e' il contenuto teorico di solvente: nell'extra). Gli autori spiegano la differenza di circa 1.5% con l'ipotesi che non tutte le molecole di cardarine abbiano un metanolo associato. Il prodotto (cardarine senza metanolo) non e' caratterizzato: a = ignota. Crogiolo: «open alumina pan».

citazioni: The endothermic peak observed in the DTA curve of bipyridine at ~75 °C is attributed to the evaporation of water absorbed on the surface and is accompanied by a mass loss of 8.3%. Furthermore, the sharp peak at ~112 °C is associated with the melting of bipyridine (Figure 7e).

citazioni: From the comparison of the temperatures at which the thermal events take place, it can be observed that all new solid forms exhibit similar behavior in terms of degradation and oxidation, which occurs at 294 °C for GW-polymorph, 281 °C and 290.5 °C for GW-MeOH, 294 °C for GW-Bipy, and 303 °C for GW-DMF. These processes are also accompanied by a great mass loss of over 50% of the total mass.

citazioni: Consequently, it is essential to store the polymorphs in a controlled environment where they are subjected to specific humidity and temperature conditions (75% relative humidity and 40 °C) in order to assess their stability.

The new polymorph and the 2:1 cocrystal samples were stored for up to three months in the climatic chamber and the powder X-ray diffraction patterns were recorded at six-week and three-month intervals, respectively. No significant structural changes occurred in the meantime with the exception that the samples became slightly more amorphous, which indicates that the samples are stable and did not suffer phase transitions (Figure S4, Supporting Information).

Cardarine, in the mono-oxidized form (GW-SO, Scheme 1e), was obtained from a solution of dimethyl sulfoxide but was not further reproduced;

The recrystallization of cardarine in dimethyl sulfoxide yielded to the formation of a new cardarine derivative, which gained an oxygen atom at the S1 sulfur of the methylsulfanyl group; in this way, the valence of S1 is 4 and becomes a sulfoxide group.
preparazioni.note: Ricristallizzazione in DMSO: la cardarine si ossida a sulfossido (derivato mono-ossidato) e il cristallo ottenuto non e' stato piu' riprodotto. Reazione chimica in soluzione durante la cristallizzazione: nessun solido di partenza e nessuna condizione di ossidazione dette, quindi preparazione e non evento.

citazioni: The new solid forms and their suitable single crystals were prepared by slow evaporation from a wide class of solvents and mixtures. The solutions were kept in the refrigerator at a temperature of 4 °C and evaporated slowly during a period of up to two months.
Cardarine, in the dioxidized form (GW-SO2, Scheme 1f), was obtained from a mixture with nitromethane and was not further reproduced anymore.

Another derivative was obtained by recrystallization in a mixture of nitromethane, which is dioxidized at the methylsulfanyl S2 sulfur, thus gaining two oxygen atoms and the valence of sulfur becomes 6. The transformation involves a sulfur atom with two carbons attached (a thioether group, C-S-C) being oxidized to a sulfonyl group (C-SO2-C), where two oxygen atoms are added to the sulfur atom. This is a process called oxidation of a thioether to a sulfone (SO2) group.
